title: SR-2.03 Every client hook verified against the real app
request: Closes G23: Codex, Gemini and Windsurf env markers admitted unverified (common.mjs:80); a vendor change silently breaks hooks. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Conformance per client
requirements: for each of 8 clients a recorded fixture of the real hook payload and env, captured from a named app version

for each client, the conformance fixture shows whether the hook's output reaches the model (for Cursor's prompt hook, src/cli/hooks.mjs:45); where it does not, docs/CLIENTS.md says so for that client and event

criteria.statement: Each client fixture parses and produces context
SR-2.03 reaches the model: each client's fixture records whether hook output reaches the model; a client whose output does not reach it and is not listed as a limit in docs/CLIENTS.md fails the test

verifier.cmd: out=$(node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^SR-2.03 reaches the model' test/clients-conformance/reach.test.mjs 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -30; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v pat='^SR-2.03 reaches the model$' 'BEGIN { n = split(pat, alt, "|") } function flush(  i) { if (cand != "") for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (cand ~ alt[i]) hit[i] = 1; cand = "" } /^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - / { flush(); name = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - /, "", name); if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*ok / && name !~ /# (SKIP|TODO)/ && name !~ /\.test\.m?js$/) cand = name; next } /^[[:space:]]*type: .suite./ { cand = "" } END { flush(); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!hit[i]) exit 1; exit 0 }'

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
